quotes.author: adam snell
quotes.text: Great day fishing with Captain Dustin with Outlaw Fishing Charters. A knowledgeable and friendly captain and he did everything from baiting the hooks, helping real in fish, handing us rods with fish on them and cleaning the fish. He let us do as much or as little as we wanted and he took the time to talk to all of us and seemed to take a genuine interest in who we were and what we were all about. Wish I could give 6 stars!!! Great communication throughout process and will be booking my next Charter with Outlaw when we come down next year! Thanks Dustin, for a great experience!

quotes.author: jon alewel
quotes.text: We had a wonderful time, the captain and first mate, were excellent, fishermen. And helped us with the whole experience. I got motion sick on the open water, but the captain took us right away into the sound where the water was very calm, and I was able to fish the rest of the trip. We caught a shark, a large sting ray (non venomous) and a bunch of other fish. Thank you outlaw fishing charters for the awesome trip out on the water.

quotes.author: brittany miller
quotes.text: Excellent company if you are considering renting a boat. We went for half day and our captain Dustin and he was very knowledgeable and helped us catch many fish. Everything was easy as he helped assist with everything and made the trip very pleasant smooth and fun. They let you keep what you catch and clean it up for you once you get back.

quotes.author: Micky
quotes.text: Captain Tommy was absolutely incredible. Had a great afternoon. Caught our limit on Drums, and had a great time just hanging out, fishing and telling stories. Extremely professional and was like fishing with an old buddy. I don’t know fishing, but I would recommend this team all day, every day

quotes.author: Megan Tropp
quotes.text: Dustin, aka “Big Country”, was awesome. Super personable, worked hard to get my family on the fish. Helped my stepdaughter (fishing for the first time - 15) with baiting and casting. Perfect for a more intimate experience! Definitely worth it!

quotes.author: Matthew Brozenick
quotes.text: Our family was on vacation, we booked a trip with Outlaw. We had Captain Dustin and had an absolute amazing time, great conversation, a lot of catches. Capt Dustin knew a lot and was super fun to go out with! Everyone caught more than 1 fish!
